propositions: pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input (jira reader hung 13.5 min at 95% CPU) because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, leaving spinning grandchildren orphaned

DC renderer must implement caller-side wall-clock timeout via proc.communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) with start_new_session=True and process-group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group to kill the entire process tree on timeout
Failed pandoc invocations (timeout, non-zero exit, or spawn failure) must degrade the affected unit to its original Markdown verbatim without raising, with no impact to other units or rendered output

pandoc binary provenance and GPL licence compliance must be recorded: pypandoc-binary wheel must be pinned to exactly one version in pyproject.toml, verified in CI, and a new repo-root NOTICE file must document pandoc 3.6.1 GPL-2.0-or-later entry
reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s config key (default 10s) must be reachable from config file and environment across schema, validator, auto-derived env var, golden config surface, and docs
rendered output across the full 178-body corpus must remain byte-identical to the landed renderer, proving the hardening changes robustness only and never alters rendering
